title: Kates Resilience Test Specification v1
description: Combined performance + chaos resilience test configuration for kates resilience run and kates resilience lint.

testRequest.description: Background Kafka load test executed during the resilience experiment.

chaosSpec.description: Chaos fault specification injected after steadyStateSec.

steadyStateSec.description: Baseline steady-state observation window in seconds before injecting the chaos fault.

maxRecoveryWaitSec.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for cluster recovery and post-chaos probes after the fault ends.

probes.description: Resilience health probes evaluated before and after chaos injection (supports kafkaProbe, k8sProbe, and cmdProbe).

wireTestSpec.description: Kates API wire-format TestSpec. Uses numRecords, numProducers, recordSize, durationMs, and throughput.

numRecords.description: Number of records each producer task sends (1..100,000,000).

recordSize.description: Payload size of each record in bytes (1..10,485,760).

durationMs.description: Maximum test duration in milliseconds (0 for record-count bounded, or 1,000..86,400,000).

throughput.description: Target producer throughput in records/sec per producer, or -1 for unlimited.

targetThroughput.description: Alias for throughput: target producer rate in records/sec, or -1 for unlimited.

topic.description: Kafka topic name (1..249 ASCII alphanumeric, '.', '_', or '-' chars).

replicationFactor.description: Topic replication factor (1..10). Must be >= minInsyncReplicas.

compressionType.description: Producer compression codec: none, gzip, snappy, lz4, or zstd.

consumerGroup.description: Consumer group ID (1..255 printable ASCII chars).

enableTransactions.description: Enable Kafka transactions (requires acks: "all", enableIdempotence: true, and backend: native).

multiPhaseScenario.description: Multi-phase scenario envelope with baseSpec, ordered execution phases, SLA definition, and metadata labels.

description.description: Human-readable description of the multi-phase scenario.

type.description: Primary test type for the scenario.

backend.description: Benchmark execution engine: native or trogdor.

baseSpec.description: Base TestSpec inherited by all phases unless overridden.

phases.description: Ordered sequence of execution phases (WARMUP, RAMP, STEADY, SPIKE, COOLDOWN).

sla.description: SLA definition evaluated across the scenario run.

labels.description: Arbitrary key/value string labels attached to the scenario.

scenarioPhase.description: A single execution phase within a multi-phase TestScenario.

type.description: Execution phase behavior: WARMUP, RAMP (supports rampSteps), STEADY, SPIKE, or COOLDOWN.

phaseType.description: Alias for type: execution phase behavior (WARMUP, RAMP, STEADY, SPIKE, or COOLDOWN).

targetThroughput.description: Target producer throughput for this phase in records/sec, or -1 for unlimited.

rampSteps.description: Number of incremental throughput steps (2..100). Only used when phase type is RAMP.

spec.description: Phase-specific TestSpec overrides merged onto scenario.baseSpec.

specOverrides.description: Phase-specific TestSpec overrides merged onto scenario.baseSpec.

slaDefinition.description: Service Level Agreement thresholds used by Kates SlaGrader to grade a test or disruption run.

p95LatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed p95 latency in milliseconds (> 0).

p99LatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed p99 latency in milliseconds (> 0).

avgLatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed average latency in milliseconds (> 0).

maxP99LatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed p99 latency in milliseconds (> 0).

maxP999LatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed p99.9 latency in milliseconds (> 0).

maxAvgLatencyMs.description: Maximum allowed average latency in milliseconds (> 0).

maxErrorRate.description: Maximum allowed error rate as a fraction between 0.0 and 1.0.

maxRtoMs.description: Maximum allowed Recovery Time Objective (RTO) in milliseconds (> 0).

maxRpoMs.description: Maximum allowed Recovery Point Objective (RPO) in milliseconds (> 0).

faultSpec.description: Parameters defining a Kubernetes or Kafka chaos fault injection.

experimentName.description: Unique identifier or Litmus ChaosExperiment name for this fault (e.g., broker-hard-crash, pod-network-loss).

targetNamespace.description: Kubernetes namespace containing the target pods.

targetLabel.description: Kubernetes label selector (e.g., 'strimzi.io/component-type=kafka,strimzi.io/broker-role=true'). Must not be empty.

targetPod.description: Specific pod name to target instead of selecting by targetLabel.

targetAll.description: When true, injects the fault into all pods matching targetLabel rather than selecting one.

chaosDurationSec.description: Fault duration in seconds (0..3600). Must be >= 1 for NETWORK_PARTITION, NETWORK_LATENCY, CPU_STRESS, MEMORY_STRESS, IO_STRESS, DNS_ERROR, DISK_FILL, and NODE_DRAIN.

delayBeforeSec.description: Delay in seconds before fault injection begins (0..600).

envOverrides.description: Litmus ChaosEngine environment overrides. Only TARGET_NODE and NODE_LABEL are permitted.

TARGET_NODE.description: Explicit Kubernetes node name to drain during NODE_DRAIN.

NODE_LABEL.description: Kubernetes node label selector used by Litmus to pick a node to drain.

targetBrokerId.description: Specific Kafka broker ID to target (>= 0), or -1 for any matching broker.

networkLatencyMs.description: Injected egress network latency in milliseconds for NETWORK_LATENCY (1..30,000).

fillPercentage.description: Target disk fill percentage for DISK_FILL or IO_STRESS (1..100).

cpuCores.description: Number of CPU cores to saturate for CPU_STRESS (1..64).

memoryMb.description: Amount of memory in MiB to consume for MEMORY_STRESS (1..32,768).

ioWorkers.description: Number of concurrent I/O worker threads for IO_STRESS (1..64).

gracePeriodSec.description: Pod termination grace period in seconds for POD_DELETE / POD_KILL (0..300).

targetTopic.description: Kafka topic name for leader-aware targeting in disruption plans (1..249 ASCII chars).

targetPartition.description: Partition index (>= 0) whose leader broker is targeted when targetTopic is set.

probes.description: Fault-scoped probes. Note: cmdProbe is forbidden inside FaultSpec.probes; use kafkaProbe or k8sProbe.

probeSpec.description: Health probe evaluated during a resilience test.

type.description: Probe execution mechanism: kafkaProbe (Kates AdminClient check), k8sProbe (Kubernetes resource check), or cmdProbe (pod exec).

mode.description: Litmus probe evaluation mode: SOT, EOT, Continuous, Edge, or OnChaos.

command.description: For kafkaProbe: 'under-replicated-partitions', 'unavailable-partitions', 'produce <topic>', or 'consumer-lag [<group>]'. For k8sProbe: 'kafka Ready'. For cmdProbe: shell command.

expectedOutput.description: Expected output string or number compared against the actual probe output.

intervalSec.description: Polling interval in seconds between probe evaluations (>= 1).

timeoutSec.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for a single probe evaluation (>= 1).

type.description: FaultSpec.probes only permits kafkaProbe or k8sProbe (cmdProbe is refused inside FaultSpec).
